description.en: Bread, market goods, frozen dishes and pili sweets to carry home.

narration.en: Casa Moderna’s pan bonete is a soft bonnet-shaped roll. A family account remembers taking home boxes of bonete and markina.

narration.en: At the People’s Mall, a pasalubong guide highlights dried anchovies and dried squid. The market also has the Siopao Center for toasted buns.

narration.en: 3N is known for toasted siopao. Its baked buns have a different texture from steamed siopao; Naga and Libmanan both figure in the origin accounts.

narration.en: For savory pasalubong, Graceland offers frozen pinangat, laing and Bicol express.

narration.en: At stalls 7 and 8 of the CBD II bus terminal, FSJ Pasalubong Sentral gathers local products. Look for bottled laing, Bicol express, ginataang santol and coco jam.

narration.en: SM City Naga has J. Emmanuel’s pili shop, with tarts, bonbon, polvoron, chocolates and spreads to take home. 1st Colonial Grill’s sili ice cream brings an Albay creation into Naga.
